items.en: The bar's search box finds apps, tools, settings, widgets, files and quick answers, and with Ask it does what a sentence says. On Windows, not in the Microsoft Store version
Files, a new tool: convert and edit images, PDFs, audio and video with Pomelo's engine, a separate program downloaded only when you ask. On Windows
The Pomelo wheel: drag files in File Explorer and hold Shift, Ctrl or Alt for Pomelo's conversions. On Windows, off by default
A Pomelo key costs US$4.99 once until 31 December 2026, bought on Stripe and filled in by a crest:// link
Translate, a new tool: text translated on the PC with the lyrics' offline models, or by the Ask provider
The tool bar shows the selected tool's name, and Behind other windows keeps the notch under every window
Hibernate in Overview when hibernation is on, and Pure black and Material's shapes for the Material style
On the taskbar, battery, Wi-Fi and volume as on an iPhone and a Mac, stocks and the Portfolio in the crypto widget, Keep room for the bar on every shape and auto-hide only on the screen in use
Crest no longer restarts Explorer as it starts with Windows keys on the bar, and the Recycle Bin widget stays up to date after Explorer restarts
A daily install count, with no ID, public at crestisland.app/stats; Count this install turns it off
The Clipboard reads the text and the QR code in a copied image: Copy text, and a link opens in the browser. On a Mac only the QR code
The Converter turns one amount into up to eight currencies at once
Left and Right move between tools while the notch is open, and Alt+Left/Right inside a text field (Cmd+Option on a Mac)
Opens on chooses what the notch opens on: the live activity, the tool open last or one tool every time
The Launcher gets an icon size and a switch for the names, and brings an app that is already open forward
The line's colour can be the closed notch's, white or the accent, and Clocks finds capitals and big cities by their own name
Lyrics are found with Spotify's Crossfade songs on

On the taskbar, emptying the Recycle Bin asks once in Crest's own panel, Search goes beside Start, and Input language shows for Chinese, Japanese and Korean too. On Windows, not in the Microsoft Store version
Windows' own volume, network and battery icons stay out of the tray, and the bar steps aside for Windows' search panel
Fixes for windows that did not come forward on a click, tray menus and white tray icons, Weather's Automatic location, Windows' Text size and more, and smoother panels and hovers
Folders on the taskbar: hold a pinned app over another to group them, and open the folder in a panel over the bar. On Windows, not in the Microsoft Store version

New taskbar widgets and faces: top apps, battery rings and cells, a network graph, Now Playing with cover and controls, the microphone, a stopwatch, the next to-do, the latest note, progress, the date, world time, more clocks, weather details, the next days, sunrise and sunset, currencies and crypto. On Windows, not in the Microsoft Store version
Windows buttons for the theme, the on-screen keyboard, the notification center, recent files and a search box

More taskbar widgets: Screen Time, the day timeline, unread notifications, device batteries, temperatures with a 10-minute line, Keep awake and a wallpaper switcher, and buttons for Do not disturb, desktop icons, Eject and the mobile hotspot
A Widget size slider, and a button that opens the widgets the bar has no room for, while the clock always stays
Pinned tools such as Portfolio, Calc, Clipboard, Ask, the Launcher and the Recorder open in a panel over the bar
A click on the weather of the Time and weather clock opens Weather, the Crest button can be removed, and windows on a monitor without a bar show on the main one
Screen Time, off until you turn it on: the time in each app, kept only on this PC for 30 days, with a Day timeline of focus rounds, events, sunrise and sunset
Wallpapers: a picture from Crest's collection or your own folder for each screen, changed on a timer if you like
The battery of your Bluetooth devices in the closed notch
The Timer goes up to 24 hours, keeps your last three durations and has a stopwatch with laps
Your local IP in Hardware opens ipconfig, the public IP shows only when you ask, and the battery health opens Windows' battery report and shows in Material too
Fixes for the equalizer's CPU use, the tool bar's width, Alt+Tab, the Animal row with the Line shape, the bar reserving its space in a loop and the Downloads preview
Jump lists, Windows' app menu and the badges and progress apps report on Crest's taskbar. On Windows, not in the Microsoft Store version
The taskbar can stand on the top edge, take Win+1 to Win+9 and Win+0, Win+T and Win+B, and combine buttons as Windows does
Pin any open app or a file dropped from File Explorer, and drag pinned apps into a new order
Windows' Search, Task view, Input language, Privacy indicators and Recycle Bin buttons, a volume mixer and a Disk space widget that finds the largest folders
The main bar's clock opens Crest's notices and calendar in one panel
The tool bar can sit under the header and lose its background, and each part of Overview has a switch of its own
Text size in Note and Calc, Core Temp as a source of the CPU temperature and apps from a file in the Launcher
A red disc that takes away a dragged bar item or notch tool, a frames per second slider for the live glass, a live Liquid Glass + tool bar in the open notch and six Start icons
Fixes for the hidden icons panel, Windows' pins with no Start entry, a Now Playing tool that got too short, the wheel on the Shelf and AI Usage's disk writes
Crest's own taskbar in four shapes, with live window previews, widgets and the Crest menu. On Windows, off by default, not in the Microsoft Store version
Glass and Liquid Glass + for the taskbar, over a live copy of the screen, on Windows 11 24H2 and later on x64, not in the Microsoft Store version
A Material style for every Crest window, with moving contour lines behind the settings, on Windows and Mac
The settings open in a window of their own
Focus mode is back: three quick clicks put the notch aside, behind a switch that is off by default
AI quota rings show the 5-hour session inside the weekly limit
Volume, brightness and other indicators can show over full-screen apps, and there are new status alerts for Copy, the output device and more
Fixes for Windows' Text size above 100%, a notch that stayed open while typing on the Mac and pictures copied twice
A LeetCode tool with problems solved, streaks and recent activity, and a closed notch part with today's count
Keep scrolling keeps a long song title moving while the song plays
Switches to take the grips off the panel's edges and to stop a hovered part from opening its tool
On Macs with Apple silicon, macOS no longer calls the app damaged
A long lyric line stays at its end until the next line
Windows' volume indicator shows while Crest is hidden
A click on a system notification opens the Notices page instead of Documents
An Insert key alert in the closed notch, off by default, on Windows
Hardware lists USB sticks, SD cards and external disks, and leaves cloud drives such as Google Drive out
On a dark theme the album cover behind Now Playing keeps the glass on
With Glass on, the top of the open panel is glass too instead of black
The gear opens Settings like any other tool, and a second click no longer goes back
Bluetooth audio no longer breaks up on some PCs while the Bluetooth devices alert is on
Notices from Windows Security and other apps that register an icon show it
A paused song shows its title again in place of the lyric line
Liquid Glass: the open panel as glass that bends and blurs the screen behind it, with four sliders. On Windows, off by default
Glass on the closed notch and the capsule too, over a live copy of the screen, on Windows 11 24H2 and later
The tool bar's highlight follows the pointer, grows under it and bounces back after a click
Day and night themes at sunrise and sunset, and the date beside the clock in the closed notch
A click on a notice in the closed notch opens its app, and Overview has play/pause and next
Lyrics stay through short pauses, and notices open as the capsule when it is the chosen look
Fixes for a browser tooltip that stayed on screen and for the privacy dot during Snipping Tool recordings
A notice opens the line into the notch for a few seconds, like a finished timer
The Claude card in AI usage stays current on Windows with the desktop app's sign-in, no terminal needed
A question from crest-notify too long to show whole is refused, so Allow never approves text you did not see
A broken or hostile calendar feed can no longer stop Crest
A sound of Crest's own when a notice pops up: ten short ones or a file of yours, with Windows' sound off for those apps
The app's own icon on notices from desktop programs like Chrome and Discord, larger on the Notices page
A notice you read in its app, like a WhatsApp message, leaves Crest too
Switching to a smaller tool no longer closes the notch
A Copy button in the Vault's password form
Focus mode is gone: three quick clicks on the notch no longer make it half transparent
A shortcut of its own for any tool, which opens the notch straight on it from anywhere
Paste directly from the Clipboard history into the app you were in, like Win + V. Off by default
Crest's own eyedropper, right on every monitor whatever its scaling, and the system's colour sampler on the Mac
Back up settings, notes, to-dos and the tools' data to a file, and restore them on this PC or another one
Web search from Overview, and Ask with a model on your PC through LM Studio or Ollama, without a key
Panel scale from 80 to 200 percent, and the album cover behind the whole panel in Now Playing
About 160 currencies in the Converter and Calc, the Vietnamese dong among them
Fixes for drags out of the Shelf, an invisible banner window that caught the pointer, and new tracks that started at their end
Six new tools, off until you turn them on in Settings, Tools: Calc, Clocks, Colour, Habits, Prompter and Agents
Break reminders: an eye break every 20 minutes and a longer one every hour of real computer time
Send Shelf files to your phone with a QR code, over your local network only
Translate lyrics offline, and show the translated or romanised line in the closed notch
AI usage shows where each limit is heading and can tell you when one resets
Copy one-time codes from notices, decode chips in the Clipboard and dates typed into new to-dos
Hide Crest from screen sharing, a microphone mute and a list of listening ports in Hardware
More than 150 fixes from a full review on Windows and the Mac, including a crash on wake from standby
Recorder: record sound only from the microphone, the system audio or both, for calls too. Off by default, turn it on in Settings, Tools
Set the brightness of the notch screen from Overview, on external monitors and a laptop screen
AI usage says when a reading is out of date and can renew an expired sign-in in Crest's terminal
A click on a notice opens what it is about: What's new, the recording, AI usage or Now Playing
Choose the app's font in Settings, Themes: sixteen fonts, each shown as itself in the menu
Report a bug from Settings, with your Crest version already filled in
Menus in Settings open upright with the notch on the bottom or a side edge
On a side edge the open panel slides along the edge again, and the resize grips and Done button are in reach
Calendar Join buttons and other links with parameters open the browser again
Light themes: the terminal and the video badges in Capture are readable
Longer translations fit in Overview, Capture, the calendar and Hardware
Arabic: sliders, level bars and the clipboard row scroll the right way
Crest starts on Windows N editions without the Media Feature Pack
Shortcuts recorded on non-US keyboards fire on the key you pressed
Left-handed mouse, a Pictures folder moved by OneDrive and file names with commas now work
Store version: the microphone is recorded
Coloured icons across the app, an option in Settings, Themes, readable on every theme
Timer and clock colours, and five new looks: Flip, Nixie, Ring, LCD and Analog
Answer a coding agent's permission request from the notch, through crest-notify ask
Join online meetings from the calendar and from the notice before an event
Pick the audio output from the volume tile in Overview
Keep awake in Overview, and the Windows power plan in Hardware
Caps Lock and Num Lock in the notch, like the volume
Focus sounds while the timer runs: white, pink and brown noise, rain and waves
Search in Settings
Temperatures and power from HWiNFO or LibreHardwareMonitor when one of them runs
Spectrum and Wave equalizers, a wavy progress bar and a tint from the album art
A Camera tool to check yourself before a call
Find text on any screen with Ctrl+Alt+F
Downloads in progress in the closed notch
Each process's CPU share in percent in Hardware
Windows notices open their app on a click, and leave the notification centre when deleted
Eight new themes: Catppuccin Mocha and Latte, Nord, Rosé Pine and Dawn, Gruvbox Dark, Solarized Light and Everforest
A click or a hover on a part of the closed notch opens its tool
Resize the closed notch, capsule or line on the notch itself, from Settings, Display
A notice in the closed notch for a new version and what it changed
The converter opens on the units and currencies used last
The weather keeps the last forecast when the service is down
Security and reliability fixes for the vault, plugins, Ask, Discord and Crest's windows
A month in the Calendar, with a dot for each calendar on days with events
The Overview clock in any of the timer looks
The Bluetooth notice for every device, with its battery, and headphones found behind audio offload drivers
Opening the notch and switching tools without the panel blur, for smoother frames
A first preview for Macs with Apple silicon and Intel
Plugins: add your own tools as sandboxed web widgets, and your own parts to the closed row with crest-notify
Crest in 11 languages, Arabic right to left; it follows Windows unless you pick one in Settings, General
A read-only Calendar from ICS links or CalDAV, with a notice before each event
A first-run setup with presets, the closed look and the shortcut
Volume and brightness in the closed notch, which can stand in for the Windows indicator
Lyrics word by word, with translation and romanisation, from more sources
With more monitors the notch can follow the pointer or sit on every monitor
A larger toolbar with a mark under the tool you are on
ARM64 builds, a SHA256SUMS file with every release and Copy diagnostics in Settings
Set the size of the closed notch, capsule and line in Settings, Display
Each reading of the closed notch sits next to its own icon, with coloured icons as an option
A currency converter at the ECB reference rates; file conversion is gone
Your profile picture in the GitHub tool, and a click on it opens your profile
The installer shows the Crest icon
Fixed the notch going blank when a timer finished
The closed notch comes as a notch, a capsule or a line, on any screen edge
A row shows cover, timer, Discord call, AI quota, title or lyrics, hardware, equalizer, clock and GitHub
Notices in the notch: recording, timer, status alerts, Windows notifications, quota, to-dos and water
Synced lyrics, an equalizer fed only by the player, and a player picker
Screenshots and screen recording with system audio and microphone
A terminal with PowerShell or Command Prompt in the notch
A launcher with pinned apps, and your GitHub activity
To-dos with due times, a water reminder and a code scratchpad
AI usage with tokens and cost from local logs, and more providers
Hardware with cores, GPUs, network, power, battery, temperatures, processes and drives
A portfolio across several brokers in one base currency, read only
Themes with an editor and a day and night switch
Rules for full screen and apps, scaling, your own shortcuts and a portable build
The interface is English only
Crest is based on L4-Notchbar 1.6.0, with its own name, updates and settings
AI usage shows the Antigravity limits instead of the retired Gemini CLI
